name: Notes and tasks
author: Brett
description: The one plugin for notes, to-dos and tasks. The Dev Console and AmberX load this same folder and read and write one store on axHub (amberx-notes: lists and items), so both show the same rows; a change on one shows on the other within seconds, no reload. Lists and sub-lists, Inbox, search, export, Today / Upcoming / Todo / All / Done, checklists, subtasks. Voice notes and the Claude files show alongside, read-only. Replaces AmberX's notes and tasks plugins and the console's Todo manager.
